before.Description: Block Rate Cap Modifier - Edit this to change the highest possible block rate against an enemy (Hard Cap) in game e.g .60 = 60%

after.Description: Block Rate Cap Modifier - Edit this to change the highest possible block rate against an enemy (Hard Cap) in game e.g .60 = 60%. Applies between players and bots only; live is 60% since 1.96

note: Server-sent NPC/object positions need no client binary patch. Geometry edits require matching client assets and rebuilt navigation.
